text:
eval-bot: nightly-eval alert: 3 suites FAILED -> instr_gen_v2, long-context-5k, legal_snippets. alert_id=ae3f2. severity=medium. deltas: instr_gen -6.2%, long-context -12.1%, legal_snippets -4.8%. report: https://internal/reports/ae3f2

maya: @tj @oliver can one of you take initial triage? seen similar drop after an int4 rollout last month :eyes:

tj: I can take instr_gen + legal_snippets. grabbing logs now. assigning to myself.

oliver: I'll take long-context-5k. my first guess: kv-cache boundary / quant edge-case with thinquant. will pull failing examples.

maya: ok pls paste a failing example and the exact model variant/config used in nightly so we can scope quant vs model change. also include batch size used.

tj: sample (instr_gen):
```
prompt: "Summarize the following legal clause and highlight exceptions..."
model: rwdl/phi-7b-int4
config: thinquant-v2, batch=16
output: "The clause states party A pays B"  // missing exception list and hedging
expected: includes 3 exception bullets
```

oliver: long-context sample:
```
input_length: 4800 tokens
model: rwdl/phi-7b-int4
config: thinquant-v2, batch=16
issue: truncation mid-reasoning, token loop at end
log snippet: kv_cache miss at step=120, then repeated tokens
```

maya: note — nightly used quant profile `thinquant-v2` and kernel set `qkern-v3` pushed yesterday. deploy-bot posted promotion around 1714999000.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: qkern-v3 promoted to canary at 1714999000; full rollout not yet.

tj: initial hypothesis: quant rounding/regression introduced by qkern-v3 for thinquant-v2. plan: 1) repro locally with same model+quant config 2) run int8 baseline 3) diff logits at critical steps / check attention scores

oliver: I'll start an isolated repro for long-context with seq=5k and kv-cache tracing on. will upload a minimal repro script to /internal/tmp/ae3f2_repro.sh and include exact cmd.

maya: sounds good. if repro shows >5% regression, bump severity to high and roll routing to int8 fallback for affected routes. owners: tj (instr_gen + legal_snippets), oliver (long-context).

tj: got a failing token-level diff for instr_gen. posting snippet:
```
step 45 logits_diff_summary:
  token=145: int8= -0.12 vs int4= -0.45
  token=146: int8= 0.03 vs int4= -0.22
conclusion: top tokens reshuffled, leads to omitted clause list
```

oliver: repro run started (job id ae3f2-ol-1). if kv_cache miss repeated we may be hitting an indexing bug in qkern-v3 for sequences >4k.

maya: quick decision tree: repro -> if confirmed, pin canary to previous qkern (qkern-v2) for the affected model family and open a hotfix PR for qkern-v3; notify infra.

sre-bot: alert: pinned qkern fallback toggles available. use toggle `quant-fallback-int8` in console to route affected customers.

tj: uploading full failing promptset to GCS: gs://redwood-evals/ae3f2/failures/instr_gen/*.json

oliver: long-context repro shows kv_cache index overflow at step 119, reproduces 8/10. attaching trace to same bucket.

maya: bumping to severity=high based on oliver repro (8/10). @infra-team loop in and schedule rollback if needed. tagging @sre for possible routing change.

tj: started bisect between qkern-v2 and qkern-v3 to isolate commit. will post commit id once found.

oliver: quick mitigation: disabling thinquant-v2 profile for phi-7b in the canary pool reduces failure to baseline. leaving note in console.

maya: meeting in 15m to handoff and plan rollback if bisect confirms qkern-v3 regression. thanks all, keep updates here. :calendar:

tj: will update with bisect results in this thread.

oliver: upload complete, will join meeting.

maya: leaving checklist: repro artifacts uploaded, owners assigned, fallback ready, meeting scheduled. if anyone sees customer-impacting incidents escalate, ping on-call SRE.

(END)
